g.text: Fraud detection: training results and baseline comparison
Same development-validation set: 88,581 transactions | 3,042 labeled fraud cases | Raw values, no smoothing
Completed and verified | 2026-10-12 20:59 ET | Added GPU time: 4h 32m 43s / 5h budget | Stopped at the 20-epoch extension cap
Selection uses validation AP; the best-AP checkpoint may not catch the most fraud at a fixed review budget.
Panel B compares the shared supervised loss. Distillation adds a separate teacher term to its total loss.
Tree lines are fixed scores: initial inputs (52 fields, seed42), enriched inputs (seed43); a pipeline comparison.
One development split and seed; epoch cap reached, convergence unconfirmed. Frozen logs and reload checks; no new training or inference.
